card.name: Ends of geographic place names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a named natural landmark or region, such as a desert, mountain, lake, plain or estuary. It often falls at the end of a name like Mt. Everest or Lake Huron in geography text.

modes.label: Mountain and lake names
modes.description: The final piece of a split-up proper name for a mountain or lake.

modes.label: Landform or region word
modes.description: A generic landform word closing a place name, such as desert, plain or city.
